title: Form B — Reconcile, certify and challenge the claim
author: monte_carlo specialist
scope: Original cross-volume foundation written reassessment with four25-point domains and twenty5-point parts, full solutions/rubrics and an independent standard-library arithmetic checker. No shared files, child agents, commits, build output or publication changed.
mechanism_distinctness: D1 uses a complete cash-versus-accrual journal and working-capital bridge, followed by early-invoice financing, nominal monthly compounding and internal-cash opportunity cost. It avoids FormA incremental-project/sunk-cost/nominal-real mechanism.

D2 uses a two-variable convex minimum, a matching dual lower certificate, a feasible-candidate gap, nonnegative/slack capacity boundaries and an exact stable capacity recurrence. It does not repeat FormA scalar contraction proof or local constrained-value calculation.

D3 combines a fully enumerated sampling-without-replacement design, exact discrete tail inference, square-root utility and bounded versus hindsight stopping. It avoids FormA Bayes-signal/value-of-information/normal-interval mechanism.

D4 uses target group weighting, within-group distortion from a tag join, an unequal-bin histogram, an input-conversion precision probe and two observationally equivalent models with opposite causal effects. It does not repeat FormA release-aware panel and simple regression dataset.

instruction_and_assumption_review: All methods are taught in accepted Volumes1–4. Relevant stock/flow and compounding, convex duality/compactness/dynamics, sampling/covariance/inference/utility/stopping and data/audit/identification chapters were read or revisited; earlier volume examination mechanisms were checked to avoid copying their full question structures.

Every part has all needed inputs and a complete solution with an explicit5-point allocation. All20 allocations sum correctly. Exact powers/fractions/square roots are accepted so a nonprogrammable calculator suffices; no external normal quantile or source lookup is needed.

The journal states simplified recognition and cash-flow classifications as exercise assumptions rather than claiming universal accounting standards. Financing uses a common comparison date and distinguishes opportunity cost from accrued expense.

The primal-dual argument retains nonnegativity in the dual domain, uses the minimization sign convention and proves a global lower bound; boundary examples do not assume interior KKT conditions continue to hold.

The finite-population design is explicit, fully enumerated and separate from the utility and stopping experiments. Bounded stopping is used only for adapted finite-horizon fair increments; hindsight is explicitly inadmissible.

Group weights do not silently assert representativeness. Histogram weights are declared. The numerical probe supplies represented values and distinguishes lost representation information from summation. Counterfactual laws are stipulated rather than inferred from perfect fit.
Claims are scoped to sampled foundational capabilities; no claim of comprehensive topic coverage, institutional qualification, empirical exam calibration or real-world evidence is made.

checks_run.command: Quiet runpy import, direct check() call and subprocess CLI from /private/tmp

independent_evidence: Checker reads the opening stocks, every transaction and firm/tag records from HTML tables. Nine separately posted double-entry journal events preserve balance after each event, independently recovering all closing stocks and retained earnings.
Operating flow is checked by cash receipts/payments and a separate profit/working-capital bridge. Financing comparisons are reconciled at future and discounted present dates with exact Fractions.

An edge-by-edge constrained minimizer independently reproduces the KKT solution.289 Lagrangian square identities and21 capacity cases check weak-duality bounds; recurrence values match the closed form and adjacent tolerance dates.

Enumerates all6 without-replacement pairs,12 ordered pairs,16 replacement pairs and4 stopping states. Exact finite-law covariance, p-values, rejection size, expected utility and hindsight differences agree.

An in-memory SQLite join independently reproduces tag multiplicity and EXISTS preserves original facts. Exact histogram shares/densities use parsed original fees. Binary64 input conversion is compared with exact integer and Fraction.from_float references.
Structure gates check four25-point domains,twenty5-point parts/allocations,four full solution groups,unique IDs,no h1,17 valid chapter routes,exam conditions and numeric answer anchors.

source_reuse.scope: Only previously taught and verified stable chapter methods are reused. No new institutional/current factual claim or empirical dataset required browsing; chapter method links are supplied for remediation.
source_reuse.originality: Original numerical records, financial journal, allocation/state path, inference/decision combination and causal counterexample. No external exam questions copied.
